I thought Shin meant the future
when he said "the world ahead," but...

rows.label: bf06440100_0040
rows.name: could he have meant the past...

rows.label: bf06440100_0050
rows.name:
And that is the key to
why they fight...?

rows.label: bf06440100_0070
rows.name: If... If that is the case...

rows.label: bf06440100_0080
rows.name: Maybe I never should have gone to sleep...
